country_data.national_production_reference_source: Government of Botswana report on Mmadinare Fish Hatchery restoration; national fish production estimate stated by the Minister of Lands and Agriculture
country_data.national_production_reference_note: National aquaculture/fish production context only: about 50 recognised fish farmers and 117 metric tonnes of fish production against a stated 5,000-tonne requirement. This is not a farm yield, farmgate price, or production-cost estimate. Fish price, yield and full operating-cost inputs remain unverified.

national_aquaculture_reference.source: Government of Botswana, Ministry of Lands and Agriculture — 2026 Budget Hansard
national_aquaculture_reference.note: National aquaculture sector output and farmer count only. Not a farm-level yield, stocking density, survival rate, production cost or farm-gate selling price. Retained as contextual evidence and not used as calculator financial inputs.

country_data.national_feed_cost_share_reference_sourc: Botswana DailyNews, Untapped resources opportunity for aquaculture growth (8 September 2026), reporting remarks by Okavango Research Institute
country_data.national_feed_cost_share_reference_note: Reported sector-level share of aquaculture production costs attributable to feed. Not a measured cost share for an individual farm and not converted into a pula cost assumption.
country_data.official_aquaculture_system_yield_refere: Government of Botswana, Development of Aquaculture in Botswana — Fisheries booklet

Published system-level production ranges, not a verified farm yield or a catfish-specific yield. The extensive and semi-intensive systems differ in stocking density, feed and management; do not apply these ranges as a default farm assumption without selecting a matching system.
